children: Zall Smart Commerce Group (02098) posted an interim loss of RMB 1.15 billion for the six months ended June 30, compared with a profit of RMB 97.05 million a year earlier, and declared no interim dividend, according to ETNet.

The company said the loss was mainly due to a net fair value loss of about RMB 1.13 billion on investment properties. Revenue fell 59.4% to RMB 36.9 billion, mainly because of lower income from its supply chain management and trading businesses. Gross profit dropped 19.6% to RMB 220 million, while the gross margin rose 0.3 percentage point to about 0.6% as the group reduced the share of lower-margin businesses and optimized its business structure to focus resources on higher-value-added operations.

title: Zall Smart Commerce Swings To RMB 1.15 Billion Interim Loss
